summary: VEILFALL: Ashes of the Nine is an isometric action RPG spanning shared Z01 chapters and a solo Veil menu stage. The world config attaches the Bladewraith and HUD; the main-place referee coordinates quests and encounters while player, enemy, boss, persistence, loot and service modules divide live state and progression.
places: places/main/ - shared Z01 adventure; sim.js owns quest chapters, NPCs, pack/boss lifecycle, rewards, progression and room sound/music.

places/main/cells/ - six authored cells cover Wayside Fire, Broken Lantern Road, Candlehold, Abbey/Crypt and Bone Stair/Ossuary, Fen/Lanternmere and Gallows Orchard; x0z0.scene holds camp services, Trophy Post and Stele of the Nine, and adds Candlehold's north gate and Pilgrims' Way.
places/main/cells/x0z1.scene - Candlehold's walled southern city square: Exchange, fountain, townhouses, lamps and curtain wall; exchange-board is the realm trade interface.
places/main/config.yaml - main terrain, atmosphere, vegetation distributions (including clustered procedural moss-oaks), arrival budget and reverb.
places/veil/ - ephemeral solo Lantern Shrine menu stage; hidden menu body is parked here; cells/config.yaml/sim.js provide shrine-ravine setting and ambience.
roots: world.config.yaml - world entry: main default, player/camera templates, lighting, arrival, nametag, desktop/touch actions and audio mix.
templates/player.js - Bladewraith body with humanoid-locomotion.js and scripts/player.js, plus carried-light child.
templates/camera.js - custom camera template running scripts/camera.js.
places/main/sim.js - Z01 referee for quests, Maelin/Ledd, packs, progression, boss spawning/reset and soundscape.
places/main/cells/ - authored playable road/chapter terrain; x0z-2.scene holds Bell Crypt/Ossuary landmarks and x0z0/x0z1 now form Candlehold and its north approach.
places/main/config.yaml - terrain and vegetation procedural distributions plus main atmosphere and acoustics.
places/veil/cells/ and places/veil/config.yaml - solo menu-stage shrine/ravine and environment; scripts/arrival.js saves an active Bearer leaving main.
shared: scripts/lib/character.js - Bearer schema, fresh state, realm roster/create/load/save/delete and packed position; player and arrival reuse it, crier and board-notes use realmOf.
scripts/db.js and scripts/lib/data/realms.yml - character and realm-bound trades schemas plus realm routing/name registry.
scripts/lib/data/economy.yml and scripts/lib/coins.js - copper denominations, drops, rewards, sell values and stock used by sim, combat, shop, HUD and crier.
scripts/lib/data/combat.yml - hero, skill, enemy and boss tuning consumed by player, wax-pack and boss scripts.
scripts/lib/data/loot.yml, loot-icons.yml and scripts/lib/loot.js - gear/drop/forge rules, rolls, smith ranks, boss marks, crafting and gear stats for combat, pack UI and trade.
scripts/lib/data/brews.yml and scripts/lib/brews.js - brew recipes, costs, rank scaling and active-brew helpers used by player, HUD and pack UI.
scripts/lib/data/trade.yml and scripts/lib/trade.js - realm listing/buy/unlist/collection logic; player routes actions here, crier and board-notes read listings; camp and Candlehold boards share it.
scripts/lib/data/veilfall-map.js - shared chapter floor gates, areas and landmarks for terrain, player and main sim; now includes Pilgrims' Way, Candlehold and Exchange coordinates.
notableExports: scripts/player.js - onSpawn, onInput, update; scripts/ui.js and ui/nametag.js - HUD/menu and nametag renderers.
scripts/abbess.js, bailiff.js, ringer.js, warden.js and hangman.js - boss onSpawn/update handlers; abbess.js owns Ossuary Abbess combat.
scripts/crier.js - onSpawn, quiet, update; scripts/board-notes.js and trophies.js - update; scripts/wax-pack.js - roll, telegraph, hurtPlayers, payout, update.
scripts/gen/oss-kit.js - skull, geometry; scripts/gen/hub-trophy.js - HOOKS, geometry, collider.
scripts/gen/cap-kit.js - material palette and local-frame box/ring/gable/beam helpers; cap-gate.js, cap-house.js, cap-wall.js and plants/mossoak.js export geometry, collider.

scripts/lib/loot.js - SLOTS, TIER, icon, BAG, rollItem, FORGE, gearStats, mitigation, freeReforges, MARKS, markBoss, applyMark, craft and smith helpers; character.js - CHAR_KEYS, fresh, START, realmOf, pack, zoneOf, rollName, roster, create, load, save, remove.

scripts/lib/shop.js and shop-ui.js - owned/shopInput and shopPanel; scripts/lib/trade.js and board-ui.js - TRADE, asks, readBoard, tradeInput and boardPanel; scripts/lib/pack-ui.js - PACK_CSS, packPanel.
ownership: scripts/lib/character.js CHAR_KEYS - persistent Bearer fields including quest/reward claims, boss flags, inventory/gear/dust/gearLife/freeUsed, smithXp, renderXp, brew, heartwax and abbesswax.

scripts/player.js - active-body movement, combat, death/i-frame and skill timers, menu/options scratch, per-Bearer floor gates, inventory/service actions and derived gear stats; proximity and chill tracking are transient; boardNear recognizes both trade-board and exchange-board.
places/main/sim.js - per-player quest/dialog/cut progression and reward claims; enemy pack/encounter spawning, boss lifecycle, room music and ambience.
scripts/wax-pack.js - ordinary enemy AI/hp/death and eligible Bearers' XP, copper, kills, shards and gear-drop inboxes.
scripts/bailiff.js, ringer.js, warden.js, hangman.js and abbess.js - respective boss hp/phases/casts/adds/defeat; participant flags, place boss rows and place.state.lastFall.
Boss scripts - first room-wide world.state.trophies[boss] record {at, by}; trophies.js derives relic visibility, plaque/stele text and transient ring/flash dedupe.
scripts/crier.js - Brother Ledd's route, pause, sale/mark/fall announcement cursors; scripts/lib/shop.js and scripts/lib/trade.js own shop/buyer state mutations and realm SQL trade rows.
flows: world.config.yaml attaches player through templates/player.js and maps actions; UI menu actions → player.js routes title/realm/character/create/enter/logout/options.
player.js menuInput → character.js roster/create/load/remove; realms.yml maps selected realm to room and Bearer fields hydrate player.state.
While player.state.menu is set, player.js hides the body and moves it to solo place veil; menu screens remain state-driven and that place has no characters.

controls.js selects menu touch surface when player/charId is absent or menu active and while shop/bag is open; otherwise world.config.yaml supplies world controls; ui.js actions return to player.js and service handlers.
player.js periodically/on rest saves changed CHAR_KEYS plus packed position → character.js writes characters; arrival.js saves an active Bearer leaving main.

player.js derives chapter floor gates from quest stage/abbeyOpenAll → veilfall-map.js floorDist governs goals and movement; Ossuary floor requires stage 23 or open-all plus Abbey/Nave access; capDist includes Pilgrims' Way and always-open Candlehold floor.
Main sim advances quests and spawns/resets bosses; boss defeats mark participants and write place.state.lastFall {boss, by, at} → crier heralds a fresh fall to a nearby camp listener.

Stage 23 + entry into OSSUARY → main sim spawns Abbess at RELIQUARY; abbess.js publishes place.state.abbess for ui.js boss bar, fights with ring/line casts and adds, then sets abbessKilled and awards heartwax/Abbess Candle to present Bearers.

Boss scripts write first room-wide world.state.trophies[boss] = {at, by} → trophies.js updates Trophy Post relic/plaque and Stele of the Nine fallen-name lights; ui/nametag.js marks Firstblood; crier announces falls and worn marks.
Firstblood names in trophies → loot.js freeReforges versus persistent freeUsed; player.js applies earned marks chronologically to items and derives gear stats.

Near Wayside forge, pack-ui craft/temper/reforge/ascend → player.js + loot.js consume materials and update inventory/gear; cauldron brew actions consume recipe resources, save timed brew/renderXp and derive combat bonuses.

Near either camp trade-board or Candlehold exchange-board → player.js boardNear sets atBoard; ui/player trade actions → trade.js read/list/buy/unlist/collect realm listings, with board-ui and crier/board-notes displaying the same market.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/hub-*.js - reusable Wayside Fire props varied by instance params, seed and scene transform; share hub-kit.js, including forge, board, trophy and cauldron; hub-board.js is reused as Candlehold's exchange-board.
scripts/gen/vf-*.js other than vf-ruin.js - Broken Lantern Road landmarks/clutter varied by params and seeds, built with vf-kit.js.
scripts/gen/vf-ruin.js - road, arena, Wax Veil approach, ashlar, braziers and Abbey door forms selected by kind/dimensions and seed.

scripts/gen/cap-kit.js and cap-gate.js, cap-house.js, cap-wall.js - Candlehold stone, timber and slate geometry share local frame/material helpers; house widths/heights/light, wall length/height and gate seed vary by placed instance.
scripts/gen/veil-land.js and veil-shrine.js - Veil ledge/cliff/ridge structures vary by kind/dimensions; shrine exports structure/hook constants.
scripts/gen/arena-floor.js, arena-pillar.js, gibbet.js and toll-throne.js - Bailiff arena dressing sharing scripts/gen/shapes.js and its wax palette.

scripts/gen/abbey-litter.js and abbey-court.js - Abbey yard/Crypt litter and court dressing; kind/seed/transform vary litter, court keeps a clear local -Z door path; scripts/gen/fen-*.js similarly share fen-kit.js for Fen paths, heart, waystones, trees and dressing.

scripts/plants/ashfern.js, gravegrass.js, bramble.js, glowcap.js and mossoak.js - procedural vegetation used by main terrain distributions; config varies density, clustering, seed, scale, tone, wind and jitter.
probableOrphans: scripts/gen/wax-figure.js - legacy procedural enemy-figure generator; current wax actors use CDN models.
migrationNotes: Persistent character data is scripts/lib/character.js CHAR_KEYS plus packed position; boss kills/resources such as heartwax and abbesswax persist, while derived gear stats, loot inbox and service proximity/chill tracking are transient.
The Veil is solo and ephemeral and parks the hidden menu body at its origin; camera.js menu framing is tuned to its shrine/ledge, while character selection can affect showcase styling.

The jukebox is room-shared: main sim chooses mood from live Bearers' area majority and boss/fight overrides; Veil sim plays menu theme when no eligible Bearer is on main. Main reverb and bus gains are configured separately.

Boss state is distinct from ordinary enemy hp: each boss publishes a place.state row and marks participants; main sim owns spawning and quest progression/reset. Boss first-fall world.state.trophies is permanent per room, distinct from per-player claims.

Boss marks/free reforges depend on trophy slayer names and timestamps, while freeUsed is per character; Ossuary floor gating uses Bone Stair/Ossuary coordinates and chapter gates in veilfall-map.js plus player.js.

Candlehold is mapped south of Wayside Fire along CAP_PATH; keep veilfall-map.js capDist/areaAt consistent with the Pilgrims' Way and city floor. The Exchange's exchange-board shares trade listings with the camp board; retain both IDs in player.js board proximity handling.
